I added a draft/published switch to posts end to end. `db/schema.ts` gains a boolean `published` column on `posts` (SQLite integer, `NOT NULL DEFAULT false`), with a generated migration at `db/migrations/20260818074526_add_published_to_posts/migration.sql` that also backfills `UPDATE posts SET published = 1` so a database that already has posts keeps them public (verified by replaying both migrations against a scratch DB: pre-existing rows come out published, new rows drafts); `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` now inserts its demo posts as published. `published` joined `Post.fillable`, `PostPayloadSchema` gained an optional `published: z.boolean().optional().default(false)` (so a create without the field is a draft), and `PostResource` exposes `published: boolean` on every serialized post — list rows, post page, edit page and search results — with codegen re-run so `ApiRoutes['posts.store'|'posts.update'].body` carries `published?: boolean`. Visibility lives in `PostController`: `index` and `search` scope to a parenthesized `published = true OR authorId = viewer` group (so drafts stay out of every list page and out of keyword search for guests and other users, while the author keeps seeing their own), `show` runs `this.can('view', ...)` and throws `NotFoundHttpException` — a 404 identical to an unused id, not a 403 — and `PostPolicy.view` now encodes that rule; `HomeController`'s "latest posts" strip is filtered to published only, since it is a public landing page. The create and edit forms (`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx`, `Edit.tsx`) got a "Published" checkbox bound to the new field, unticked by default on create and pre-filled from the post on edit. New coverage is in `tests/PostDrafts.test.ts` (real DB via `resetDatabase()`), exercising guest/other-user hiding in the list and search, the author's access to their draft's page and edit form, draft-by-default and publish-on-create, and publish/unpublish through the edit form.
